name: Windows TCP SYN Attack Protection Enabled
description:
Deprecated: SynAttackProtect is ignored by the TCP/IP stack since Windows Vista and Windows Server 2008, where SYN attack protection is always on. The rule is kept inactive for compatibility with existing imports and will be removed in a future release. Ensures Windows SynAttackProtect is enabled (1), improving resilience against SYN flood attacks.
Required Windows permission (remedy only): the LEA agent account must be allowed to run reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters /v SynAttackProtect (administrator rights) via a delegated run-as permission, Scheduled Task, or service configuration.

remedy.command: reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters /v SynAttackProtect /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f | Out-Null; reg query HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters /v SynAttackProtect
